description: Sunt Bianca si iubesc tot de tine de spatiul cosmic, acest proiect fiind o oportunitate de a gasi oameni cu aceasta pasiune.
summary:
Our project is an interactive educational application that brings forgotten NASA equipment on the Moon and Mars back into the spotlight.

Through first-person stories, users discover the journeys, achievements, and challenges of space explorers such as Opportunity and Spirit. The application also includes an educational game and presents real problems faced by space equipment, together with possible engineering solutions.

Our goal is to make space exploration fun and accessible, inspire curiosity, and show that even equipment whose missions have ended has left an important legacy.
